zh-CN: HTML 短命令现在可根据 HTML 模板根节点声明自动选择 HTML-DOC 或 HTML-SLIDES；无模板和未声明的历史模板仍默认使用 HTML-DOC。
HTML-DOC 与 HTML-SLIDES 默认将支持的本地图片转为 Base64 嵌入单个 HTML；--copy-assets 可将图片复制到相邻资源目录。图片支持点击放大、拖动平移、滚轮缩放及快捷关闭。
安装包新增 HTML 报告模板指南和 floradoc-multiformat Agent Skill，并更新中文使用说明。
en: HTML short commands now select HTML-DOC or HTML-SLIDES from the root declaration in a supplied HTML template. No template and undeclared legacy templates continue to default to HTML-DOC.

HTML-DOC and HTML-SLIDES embed supported local images as Base64 in one HTML file by default. --copy-assets copies images to an adjacent assets directory. Images support click-to-enlarge, drag panning, wheel zoom, and keyboard/backdrop dismissal.
The package now includes the HTML report template guide and floradoc-multiformat Agent Skill, with an updated user guide.

zh-CN: 无需单独安装 .NET SDK、Python 或 Microsoft Word。
en: No separate .NET SDK, Python, or Microsoft Word installation is required.

zh-CN: 安装器：下载并运行 FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe，按向导安装，重新打开 PowerShell 后运行 floradoc --version。
便携 ZIP：解压到可写目录，在目录内运行 .\floradoc.exe --version；可将目录加入 PATH 以便从其它位置调用。
安装器版本可用 floradoc update 检查更新；便携 ZIP 通过下载新版并重新解压更新。
en: Installer: run FloraDoc-Setup-win-x64.exe, follow the setup wizard, open a new PowerShell window, and run floradoc --version.
Portable ZIP: extract it to a writable directory and run .\floradoc.exe --version there. Add the directory to PATH to call it elsewhere.
Installer-based installations can check for updates with floradoc update. Update a portable ZIP by downloading and extracting the new archive.
